name: What is the typical cost for Schema Markup implementation for a law firm?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for Schema Markup implementation for a law firm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost for Schema Markup implementation for a law firm can vary widely based on the complexity of the website, the number of pages, and the extent of specific schema types required. It can range from a few hundred dollars for basic implementation on a small site to several thousand for comprehensive markup across a large, multifaceted firm website by an agency. Some firms may offer it as part of a broader SEO package.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies widely, from a few hundred to several thousand dollars, depending on website complexity and required schema types.
